entries.formulaBefore: maxDDpct was copied into both volatility and maximum drawdown
entries.formulaAfter: sample standard deviation (N-1) of annual portfolio returns, expressed in percent; no additional annualization factor
entries.expectedDirection: not monotonic; volatility and drawdown become independent risk measures

entries.formulaBefore: absolute count of successful years with cutPct >= 10, including accumulation years
entries.formulaAfter: completed decumulation years with finite cutPct >= 10 divided by completed decumulation years with a finite cut decision; denominator zero is nullable
entries.expectedDirection: unit and denominator change; old and new values are not directly comparable

entries.formulaBefore: household care triggers were assigned to P1 and absent person entries were stored as age zero
entries.formulaAfter: P1 and P2 use separate observed-entry counters over requested runs; conditional person distributions exclude non-entry sentinels and expose sampleSize plus missingness
entries.expectedDirection: person rates and conditional medians may move independently; empty distributions change from zero to null

entries.formulaBefore: DepotStart minus DepotEnd was labelled as depot-financed care cost and annual household spend used max(P1 target, P2 target)
entries.formulaAfter: modelled annual care additions passed to the simulation are summed as P1 plus P2, accumulated per person and household, and reported in real EUR at simulation-start prices; nominal path fields use the NominalEur suffix
entries.expectedDirection: values are not comparable because attribution, household addition and price basis change

entries.formulaBefore: median with care minus median without care despite the opposite UI description
entries.formulaAfter: real-EUR median without care minus real-EUR median with care, explicitly marked as an unpaired non-causal group comparison
entries.expectedDirection: sign reverses relative to the old implementation

entries.formulaBefore: technical errors were separated, but financial terminal reasons were not exposed as an exhaustive inventory and the UI derived a generic success rate from failCount
entries.formulaAfter: each requested run is exactly ruin, all_dead, horizon_exhausted or technical_error; floor coverage is (all_dead + horizon_exhausted) / requestedRuns only for technical-error-free batches and otherwise null
entries.expectedDirection: headline becomes nullable on technical error and censored horizon paths become explicitly visible

entries.formulaBefore: duration and depletion age used Uint8 with sentinel 255; Monte Carlo used 0.0005 outside the mortality table while Sweep used 1
entries.formulaAfter: duration and age use Uint32 plus explicit missingness; all simulator paths use probability 1 outside the mortality table and reject age-plus-horizon overflow
entries.expectedDirection: buffer storage increases by 7 bytes per run; valid in-range paths are unchanged while out-of-range mortality fails closed consistently

entries.formulaBefore: the selected CAPE/filter/recency start record initialized historical lookback only; fixed block, stationary and regime methods immediately performed a separate first-year draw and fixed-block eligibility excluded the final complete start index
entries.formulaAfter: the selected start record is the first method-specific simulated record; fixed block continues a complete sequential first block, stationary applies restart probability only afterwards, Markov transitions after the start regime and IID becomes independent after the start record
entries.expectedDirection: identical seeds intentionally produce different sampled paths and therefore potentially different financial outcomes; the direction is not monotonic and is accepted only against GC-SAMPLING-01 and the Post-Slice-06 snapshot

entries.formulaBefore: sampling method, effective start source, drawn-year inventory, regime counts, tail-risk counters and data version were not available as one chunk-mergeable contract
entries.formulaAfter: MonteCarloSamplingDiagnosticsV1 carries the effective MonteCarloSamplingContractV1, O(historical-year-domain) start/year/source/regime counters, stationary restart counts, reconciled tail-risk counters and annual/regime data hashes
entries.expectedDirection: new diagnostic fields only; worker payload grows with the bounded historical-year domain, not with runs times years

entries.formulaBefore: floor coverage exposed a point estimate over requested runs without estimator uncertainty
entries.formulaAfter: technical-error-free floor coverage exposes numerator, requested-runs denominator, point estimate and Wilson 95 percent interval; technical_error suppresses estimate and interval fail-closed
entries.expectedDirection: the point estimate is unchanged for clean batches; new interval and small-sample warning fields are added

entries.formulaBefore: main CaR pooled annual withdrawals from runIdx modulo 100 paths and stress CaR omitted post-ruin zero years
entries.formulaAfter: each evaluable run contributes one P10 scalar over its decumulation window, with zero fill after ruin while someone lives; across-run P10/P50 use equal run weights and explicit missingness; stress uses the same zero fill inside its fixed window
entries.expectedDirection: values are not directly comparable; early-ruin paths can lower the estimator and length bias is removed

entries.formulaBefore: the first engine year persisted withdrawal rate zero and the wealth fallback subtracted pension income a second time from an already netted need
entries.formulaAfter: first and later engine years derive withdrawal rate from the current net need; the wealth fallback consumes the already pension-netted need exactly once; hard floor quantization and exhausted flex-budget zero remain invariant
entries.expectedDirection: path-level real withdrawal P10, volatility, drawdown and cut-year share may move in either direction; aggregate real-withdrawal P10, observation counts, missingness, outcome inventory and floor coverage remain unchanged for GC-CAR-01

entries.formulaBefore: an explicit maxSkimPctOfEq zero fell through || 5 to a five-percent opportunistic equity-sale cap; the dry-run omitted the aggregate equity budget and the sale engine treated a non-positive aggregate budget as unlimited
entries.formulaAfter: an explicit maxSkimPctOfEq zero remains a hard zero cap in opportunistic and surplus paths; the dry-run forwards the aggregate equity budget and the sale engine distinguishes absent budget from an explicit zero budget
entries.expectedDirection: financial path effects are not monotonic; for the fixed GC-CAR-01 reference only run index 5 volatility and maximum drawdown plus derived median volatility decrease slightly, while every other captured field remains exact

entries.formulaBefore: the canonical path result retained no per-run realized withdrawal-rate statistic; optimizer end-wealth P25 reused P10, drawdown seed batches were averaged from batch quantiles and Median_WR was the constant zero
entries.formulaAfter: each evaluable run retains the arithmetic mean of finite realized withdrawal rates from calculated decumulation years, including the actual terminal ruin year with jahresEntnahmeEffektiv (the actual payout only) as its numerator, plus observation count and explicit missingness; canonical raw final-wealth and drawdown distributions exclude and classify technical paths; pooled linear-interpolation quantiles and the D-14 across-run median feed a strictly versioned, numeric-only optimizer contract whose safety penalty rejects a missing withdrawal rate
entries.expectedDirection: transfer buffers grow exactly from 93 to 106 bytes per run; the 100000-run standard measurement records 977.62585 total worker-result bytes per run and the resource contract rounds this to 978; existing non-ruin financial paths and previously captured KPIs remain exact; actual ruin paths retain their terminal observation while a pre-payout ruin contributes an observed zero payout rather than residual wealth, technical paths can no longer improve end-wealth or drawdown ranking through zero initialization, and the now-active withdrawal-rate safety term may change candidate rankings

entries.formulaBefore: semantic Post-Slice references 03 through 07 existed separately; later export, lifecycle, resource, browser and alias-removal contracts had no integrated final candidate
entries.formulaAfter: the final candidate retains every immutable semantic reference and records V1 contract versions, resource bounds, fixed worker/chunk provenance, absence of expired read aliases, terminal outcomes, risk, care, run-based real withdrawal, sampling diagnostics and technical inventory without changing financial formulas
entries.expectedDirection: no financial KPI direction; exact same-runtime integration equality is required and every unexplained delta blocks

entries.formulaBefore: Monte Carlo sampled the prior embedded global-equity annual return chain and its derived regime inventory
entries.formulaAfter: Monte Carlo samples the reproducible global_equity_research_index annual returns built from JST R6, OECD share-price and ECB exchange-rate inputs; the USD proxy includes 1950 and German investor-currency conversion starts with 1951, so the reconstructed German 1949-to-1950 factor cannot become a global return; derived regimes and data fingerprints follow the remediated chain
